components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            present it is combined with the lastName to form the read-only
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional flat form, retained
            for backward compatibility: an owner may instead supply the
            structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields. On read this is the
            composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present — or the
            normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Optional; when a non-blank value is supplied the
            structured fields are preferred over the flat 'address'. Normalized
            on create the same way as 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). Normalized on create the same way as 'addressLine1'
            and, when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be four digits and, for a city whose
            region is known (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), must fall within that region's range; a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only control flag for create. The household is keyed on the
            computed householdId (derived from lastName and postcode), so when
            another owner already shares the same lastName and postcode the
            create is normally rejected with 409; setting this to true
            acknowledges the shared household and allows the create to proceed
            as a declared household member (which is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Never persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:

            salutation:
              title: Salutation

                lastName when no title is set.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived
                on read: the leading '+' and country code, a space, then the
                national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household,
                assigned on create as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). All owners sharing the same
                lastName and postcode — for example those joining an existing
                household via 'sharesHousehold' — receive the same value.

                identityKey equals that of an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3a7f2c1b9d4e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last
                two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived on read. Points start at 0
                and accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is
                0, 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and 3 when the owner's
                tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived on read by mapping
                membershipPoints to a level: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points,
                3 for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6 or more points. Because a new owner
                has zero tenure, level 4 is reached only once tenure passes 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived on read from the owner's locality
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when
                the locality is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is set.
              type: string
              enum:

                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:

              description: >-

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I changed owner deletion from a hard delete to a soft delete. The implementation:

**Domain / persistence**
- `Owner.java` — added a `deleted` boolean field (`@Column(name = "deleted", nullable = false)`), defaulting to `false`, with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted()`. A newly created owner is therefore `deleted = false`.
- Added the `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` column to all four schema files (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`). The test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema change is what actually creates the column.

**API contract**
- `openapi.yml` — added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct auto-maps it. `GET /api/owners/{id}` now returns `deleted`.

**Behavior**
- `ClinicServiceImpl.deleteOwner` now sets `deleted = true` and saves (retaining the row) instead of `ownerRepository.delete(owner)`. The controller still returns `204 No Content` (2xx), and `GET` afterwards returns the owner with `deleted = true`.
- `OwnerRestControllerV1` — the duplicate check (`rejectDuplicateHousehold`) and the identity check (`rejectDuplicateIdentity`) now filter out `deleted` owners, so a normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only matching owner has been soft-deleted.

Both Cp46 scenarios pass: the soft-delete-flags-and-retains case and the deleted-owner-ignored-by-duplicate-check case, with no regressions across the other 56 tests.
